tools.name: get_latest_results
tools.description: Returns the official newest 4D draw result for every operator (Magnum, Da Ma Cai, Sports Toto, Singapore 4D, Sabah 88, Sandakan STC, Sarawak Cash Sweep, Grand Dragon, Perdana including its afternoon draw, and 9 Lotto). Official results only; no number recommendations or forecasts.

tools.name: get_results_by_date
tools.description: Returns every operator's official 4D draw result for a given calendar date. Returns an empty result set with a note if no draws happened that date. Official results only; no number recommendations or forecasts.

tools.name: get_operator_results
tools.description: Returns one 4D operator's most recent official draw results (1st, 2nd, 3rd, special and consolation numbers), newest first. Official results only; no number recommendations or forecasts.

tools.name: lookup_number
tools.description: Lists every official 4D draw in which a given 4-digit number appeared as a winning number, with its date, operator and prize tier. Past winning appearances only, not a ranking. Official results only; no number recommendations or forecasts.

tools.name: get_other_game_results
tools.description: Returns official results for 4D-family games other than the main draw: Toto 5D/6D/Star/Power/Supreme, Magnum Life/Jackpot/Gold, Da Ma Cai 3+3D/Jackpot, and Singapore Toto, including numbers, bonus numbers and jackpot amounts. Official results only; no number recommendations or forecasts.

tools.name: get_draw_schedule
tools.description: Returns the official upcoming 4D draw schedule (regular and special draw dates) and which operators draw on each date, from the site's calendar. Official results only; no number recommendations or forecasts.
